title: WR-90 with a lossy dielectric layer (εr = 2.25, tan δ = 0.02) filling its lower half, 20 mm long: the hybrid lossy LSM₁₀ mode through ports solved on the layered cross-section
source: The LSE and LSM modes of a rectangular guide loaded with a dielectric slab across its width (R. E. Collin, Field Theory of Guided Waves, 2nd ed., IEEE Press 1991, §6.1; R. F. Harrington, Time-Harmonic Electromagnetic Fields, 1961, §4-7), the LSM^y equation −(k_y1/εr) tan(k_y1 d) = k_y2 tan(k_y2 (b − d)) with the complex εr = 2.25(1 − 0.02j), solved in complex arithmetic by following the lossless root as the loss grows (Newton's method; emcraft_theory::slab::slab_loaded_modes_lossy, checked against these values by its own test); S21 = e^{−γL}, S11 = 0
